text:
Lin Chen: Hey all! Excited to join Redwood Inference as a Developer Advocate. Based in Toronto, usually remote but visiting SF in late April. I bring terrible puns and an excellent cat (Miso) who may be on camera.
Maya Chen: Welcome Lin!!! :wave: Miso is already a VIP in our hearts. If you're in SF, let's grab ramen.
DevEx Bot: Welcome @Lin Chen! You've been added to #devex and granted access to DevKit: https://redwood.company/devkit (automated)
Omar Z.: hi lin, welcome aboard. FYI we do a short lightning talk slot every other Thursday called "2 slides, 5 minutes"  you should totally do one about deploy-stage memes :)
Samir: Heads up: office plants run on snacks. Please do not feed the ficus with soy sauce.
Lin Chen: Thanks all 97 I'd love to do a lightning talk. Topic idea: "shipping a demo that actually runs on a non-ideal GPU" 97 short and messy, but honest. Also: is there a slack ritual for new hires?
Maya Chen: We have the picnic + a silly "two truths one lie" round on the courtyard bench. No pressure.
Omar Z.: Also a big meme drop on Fridays in #random. Bring your best SRE-era comic.
Samir: Sent a calendar invite for a quick intro chat Wed 11am PT. I'll walk you through PR templates and the dev VM.
Lin Chen: Allergy note: severe shellfish. Will avoid team sushi nights, but happy to bring cupcakes (peanut-free) instead.
Maya Chen: Cupcakes = hero status. See you Wed! :cupcake:
